description:
Hello! We are Piyasa Team.

We aim to join this outstanding competition, gain experience, and grow together. Our goal is to develop a practical solution that helps our planet and builds a better future.

We specialize in agriculture and weather forecasting, using our knowledge and creativity to solve real-world challenges.

We hope this competition is memorable for all competitors and everyone who organizes and supports it.

Thank you for this opportunity!

Sincerely,
Piyasa Team We look ahead.
